column1: # FROZEN BEFORE THE FIRST cl.exe OF select_grid.cpp — lane wb-select (WB-I), 2026-08-09.
# Scored in docs/whitebox/WB_SELECT_FINDINGS.md §7.  A cell whose premise fails is
# scored a MISS, not excluded (wb-regalloc §7.4's rule, inherited).
# WHAT THE READING SAYS, in the form the cells test
#  A value-producing relational reaches FUN_10c1b517 @ 0x10c1b517 as tuple
#  opcode 0x2ea.  It races two expanders, both of which return a COST when
#  called with param_2 == 0 and EMIT when called with param_2 == 1, and the
#  driver takes the cheaper with TIES GOING TO B:
#    A = FUN_10c1ac5c @ 0x10c1ac5c   the CARRY idiom
#        normalise the relation to canonical `local_c >u local_8` using
#          rel 1 (==)  -> swap the two RESULT values, become rel 2
#          rel 2 (!=)  -> require the compare's 2nd operand to be constant 0,
#                         become rel 8
#          rel 7 (<u)  -> swap the COMPARE operands, become rel 8
#          rel 9 (<=u) -> swap the two RESULT values, become rel 8
#          rel 10 (>=u)-> swap COMPARE operands, become rel 9, then as rel 9
#          anything else (3,4,5,6 = the SIGNED relations, and the floats)
#                      -> return 500  == infeasible
#        then emit, with base = second result operand and delta = first - second:
#          [li rT, K]                if local_c is a constant       (+1 cost)
#          subfic rD, local_c, SIMM  if local_8 is a 16-bit constant
#          subfc  rD, local_c, local_8   otherwise                  (base 2)
#          lcarry (0x28c)  ->  subfe rD,rD,rD      == XER[CA] - 1
#          [rlandi rD, 0, delta]     unless delta == -1             (+mask cost)
#          [addi rD, rD, base]       unless base == 0               (+1)
#        so `cost` is a word count, and mask = -1 exactly when the canonical
#        relation is TRUE.
#    B = FUN_10c1af2d @ 0x10c1af2d   the CNTLZW idiom
#        requires the compare's 2nd operand to be the constant 0 OR the
#        relation to be == / != ; requires the two result values to differ and
#        |delta| == 1 or {0, power of two}.  Emits
#          [addi rD, x, -K]  or  [subf]   to bring the compare to zero
#          [cntlzw]                        an extra one for a SIGNED relation
#          cntlzw rD, rD
#          rlandi rD, 27, 1   == rlwinm rD,rD,27,31,31 == srwi rD,rD,5
#          [xori rD, rD, 1] [neg] [addi base] [rlandi log2(delta)]
#  and FUN_10c1b315 @ 0x10c1b315 is the profitability gate applied upstream in
#  p2\misc.c (caller 0x10b813f1): if-convert only when 2*cost < 20 at /O1
#  (DAT_10c2e310 == 0) or cost < 10 under favour-speed.  cost 500 therefore
#  means NO branchless form at all.
# THE RIVALS
# R-LC1  the `lcarry` pseudo expands to `subfe rD,rD,rD` and the base is a
#        separate `addi rD,rD,base`   (what FUN_10c1ac5c literally emits)
# R-LC2  a later peephole folds `subfe rD,rD,rD` + `addi rD,rD,base` into
#        `li rT,-base` + `subfze rD,rT`  (same word count)
#        -- R-LC2 is registered because the calibration cell wbk_4 showed
#           exactly that shape and FUN_10c1ac5c does not contain it.
# R-M1   the rlandi mask expands to `rlwinm rD,rD,0,mb,me` when the mask is a
#        contiguous bit run
# R-M2   the rlandi mask expands to `andi. rD,rD,mask` when it fits 16 bits
# R-SB1  `x < 0` as a value is a one-word `srwi rD,rX,31`, i.e. a peephole
#        beats the read cntlzw/cntlzw/srwi form
# R-SB2  `x < 0` as a value is the read three-word cntlzw/cntlzw/srwi form
# COLUMNS
#   cell | predicted mnemonic sequence (PRIMARY, graded) | predicted words with
#   registers (SECONDARY, graded separately) | predicted cost | rival elected
cell
wbs_s1
column3: li r11,10 / subc r10,r3,r11 / subfe r10,r10,r10 / addi r3,r10,2 / blr
